author: Fourhead
body:
Good Afternoon. Let's start by being honest, I don't ever remember playing this server, a friend wanted me to play and it said I was banned sometime march 2015 for ban evasion. So, I am sorry for evading my ban and whatever else may have caused it to come to this.

Sincerely, 
Fourhead
